tasks.title: Place ThemeToggle on the login page and confirm dark rendering
acceptance_criteria: ThemeToggle is rendered on the login page, pinned top-right via .adm-login-toggle (absolute), without disturbing the centered card.
The page reads all colors from themeStyle / var(--adm-*) so it renders dark under data-theme="dark" with no hard-coded theme colors introduced (card shadow rgba is theme-agnostic and acceptable).
tests: LoginPage renders a theme toggle button
LoginPage still renders the login form (identifiant/mot de passe, Se connecter) and disables submit when empty
